Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the scre enshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 2. Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by bank (if any). 3. Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any respon sibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates 10 / 15 (whiche ver is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 4. Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy a vailable to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if : i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated

Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purc hase Order on the Seller. 5. Any counter terms to this bid is not entertained. 6. Payment of premium will be made before the starting of policy period. 7. Any corrigendum to this bid will be intimated through text based ATC. 8. For any clarifications to this bid feel free to contact to the below: Smt. Radhika, AGM (Fin) Landline: 040-23456171 / 117. Timings: between 09:30 Hrs to 17:00 Hrs. .
